tf:might_mage_str: Every tower was carried up one stone at a time.
tf:might_ranger_int: She read the sky before every long shot.
tf:might_ranger_str: A war bow is drawn with the back, not the arms.

tf:might_warrior_dex: Heavy steel, quick feet. The dead had it the other way round.
tf:might_necromancer_str: Somebody has to dig them up first.
tf:might_paladin_dex: A thousand miles of road teach the feet their own prayers.
tf:might_samurai_int: The same hand writes the poem and draws the sword.
tf:rimebound_n0: Cold is patient. It only has to be patient once.
tf:rimebound_n1: The frost on your coat is older than your oath.
tf:rimebound_n2: Spring was a promise. You did not make it.
tf:oath_of_the_long_night: The night does not end. It is only waiting for you to stop.
tf:kindled_n0: A fire that is fed a little every hour never goes out.
tf:kindled_n1: Keep watch by the pyre. It keeps watch by you.
tf:kindled_n2: The second hour of a fire is worse than the first.
tf:oath_of_the_pyre: Every vow is kindling. Yours burned the brightest.
tf:snarewright_n0: The best hunter is the one who was never there.
tf:snarewright_n1: Lie still long enough and the forest forgets you.
tf:snarewright_n2: A trap does not miss. It only waits for its moment.
tf:oath_of_the_snare: You never fight. You only arrive after it is over.
tf:temper_warrior: Iron learns the forge. So does the hide that wears it.
tf:temper_paladin: The blow arrives as iron and leaves as embers.
tf:temper_ranger: Rain, frost and lightning taught the cloth what the arrow could not.
tf:temper_samurai: Breathe in the storm. Let the blade pass through it.
tf:temper_mage: The ward does not stop the hammer. It turns it into weather.
tf:temper_necromancer: Dead bone does not break. It goes cold.
tf:stormbound_n0: One bolt is weather. Two is a warning.
tf:stormbound_n1: The storm does not end with the man it struck.
tf:stormbound_n2: Hold the charge a heartbeat longer.
tf:oath_of_the_living_storm: The sky remembers every oath sworn under it.
tf:wildfire_n0: Burn one tree and you have burned the forest.
tf:wildfire_n1: A second fire on the same coal burns hotter.
tf:wildfire_n2: The wind is the arsonist's best friend.
tf:oath_of_many_fires: Many small fires. One great burning.
tf:shatterglass_n1: The cold does not hurt. It only takes.
tf:oath_of_the_white_silence: Snow falls on the battlefield. Nothing else moves.
tf:bloodletter_n0: An axe does not need to kill. It only needs to open the door.
tf:bloodletter_n2: The wolves smell it before you do.
tf:oath_of_the_red_harvest: The field is red. The harvest is in.

tf:crimson_edge_n1: It trails behind them like a banner.
tf:crimson_edge_n2: Small wounds. Many of them. Patience.
tf:oath_of_a_thousand_cuts: The master does not strike hard. The master strikes often.
tf:slowruin_n0: What the hit begins, the hour completes.
tf:slowruin_n1: The wound is the doorway. The rot walks in.
tf:slowruin_n2: Nothing in the grave is ever in a hurry.
tf:oath_of_slow_ruin: Everything ends. You only make sure of it.
tf:stormarrow_n0: Every arrow carries a little of the sky.

tf:stormarrow_n2: Pull the string tighter. Let the storm wait.

tf:emberblade_n2: Steel remembers the fire that made it.
tf:rimeward_n0: Even the faithful break when frozen.

tf:rimeward_n2: Cold enough to keep a saint.

tf:r79_intstack_k0: Every thought you have is a spell waiting.
tf:oath_of_the_rolling_thunder: Every arrow is a cloud. Every volley, a storm.
